scope_comparison: Target no nonvanishing detection advantage for k=n^(1/2-epsilon). Kunisky–Mao's current algorithms require k>=lambda sqrt(n) with fixed positive lambda; no substitution lambda=n^-epsilon preserves their fixed-parameter polynomial guarantee. Recovery in random geometric graphs also differs.
